paper.title: Accurate and Robust Stellar Rotation Periods catalog for 82771 Kepler stars using deep learning

result.summary: 本文提出了 LightPred，一个用于从光变曲线中提取恒星自转周期的深度学习模型，采用 LSTM 与 Transformer 的双分支架构 [S6.p1]。模型先使用 Kepler 数据进行自监督对比预训练，再用基于模拟光变曲线的监督学习进行训练 [S4.SS2.p1]。评估表明 LightPred 在准确性和平均误差上优于自相关函数等经典方法，尤其在噪声数据上表现更好 [S6.p2]。作者将其应用于 Kepler 数据集，生成了迄今最大的主序星自转周期目录，包含超过 80000 颗恒星 [S6.p2]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在从光变曲线中准确、稳健地提取恒星自转周期，以应对经典方法在大数据集上耗时且难以处理复杂光变曲线的挑战 [S1.p2]。作者指出，基于模拟数据的深度学习方法此前仅用于 TESS 样本的周期预测，尚未用于 Kepler 样本，且自监督学习在周期测定中从未被使用过 [S1.SS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: Classical methods for measuring rotation periods, such as Lomb-Scargle periodograms and autocorrelation functions, have been successful (,,,,,,,) but can be time-consuming and challenging to apply to large datasets.
Furthermore, these methods often struggle with complex light curves that exhibit multiple periodicities or evolving spot patterns.
Simulation-based learning for period determination was done only by and for predictions of TESS samples and not for Kepler samples.
To the best of our knowledge, the use of self-supervised learning for period determination was not done at all.

method.text: LightPred 采用双分支架构，结合 LSTM 和 Transformer 组件以同时捕捉时间依赖和全局特征 [S6.p1]。训练分为两步：首先用 Kepler 样本进行自监督对比学习预训练，然后将权重作为初始化，在模拟光变曲线数据集上进行监督训练 [S4.SS2.p1]。模拟数据由 Butterpy 生成，基于简化的星斑模型 [S2.SS1.p1]。模型同时预测周期和倾角，利用互学习提升周期测定 [S2.SS1.p2]。

evidence.quote: By leveraging a dual-branch architecture that incorporates LSTM and Transformer components, LightPred excels at capturing both temporal dependencies and global patterns within light curves.
To train the model, we used a 2-step pipeline; First, we trained the model, without the prediction head, in a self-supervised fashion, with Kepler samples.
Next, we used the weights from the SSL Step as an initialization for supervised training with the mock dataset.
To create a dataset for supervised training we used simulated light curves using Butterpy, a python package described in.
By training a model to predict periods and inclinations at the same time we rely on the fact that mutual learning can benefit both aspects independently.

experiments.text: 监督训练使用 50000 个模拟样本，每个样本时长为 1000 天，按 81%、9%、10% 划分为训练、验证和测试集 [S4.SS2.p1]。作者将数据集加倍至 100000 样本，发现结果无显著变化，因此保持 50000 样本 [S4.SS2.p1]。模型在 Kepler 数据集上应用，生成超过 80000 颗主序星的周期目录 [S6.p2]。

evidence.quote: This was done on a dataset of 50000 simulated samples of 1000 days that were generated as explained in II.1 and II.2.
We then split the dataset into training ( $81\%$), validation ( $9\%$), and test sets ( $10\%$).
We experimented with doubling the dataset size to 100000 samples and found no significant change in the results so we decided to keep the dataset size with 50000 samples.
This advancement has led to the generation of the largest and most accurate catalog of stellar rotation periods for main-sequence stars to date, comprising over 80000 stars.

findings.text: LightPred 在准确性和稳健性上优于自相关函数等传统方法，尤其在噪声数据上表现更好 [S6.p2]。作者生成了迄今最大的主序星自转周期目录，包含超过 80000 颗恒星 [S6.p2]。通过基于学习置信度和一致性度量的误差分析，作者过滤了预测并移除了与星斑诱导变率不同的恒星类型 [abstract]。分析显示误差水平与恒星参数之间存在强相关性，并确认了轨道周期短于 10 天的食双星中的潮汐同步现象 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: Our training process, combining simulated and real Kepler data, has allowed LightPred to outperform traditional methods like the Autocorrelation Function in terms of accuracy and robustness, particularly for noisy data.
This advancement has led to the generation of the largest and most accurate catalog of stellar rotation periods for main-sequence stars to date, comprising over 80000 stars.

Using error analysis based on learned confidence and consistency metric, we were able to filter the predictions and remove stellar types with variability which is different than spot-induced variability.
Our analysis shows strong correlations between error levels and stellar parameters.
Additionally, we confirm tidal synchronization in eclipsing binaries with orbital periods shorter than 10 days.

limitations.text: 模拟数据基于简化的星斑模型，存在倾角与星斑位置之间的内在简并，且模型依赖先验分布，星斑分布对结果有很大影响 [S2.SS1.p1]。星斑纬度分布、衰减和周期重叠等模式是否与其他恒星一致尚不清楚，且恒星周期与星斑总覆盖度之间的关系是统计性的，难以应用于特定恒星，因此未在模拟中实现 [S2.SS1.p1]。

evidence.quote: The suggested model implies an inherent degeneracy between inclination and spot location.
This implies that the model is prior-depended: the distribution of spots in the model has a large effect on the results.
However, it is not well known whether this pattern (latitude distribution, decay, and cycle overlap) is consistent with other stars.
However, as stated in, this relation is of a statistical nature, and applying this relation to the spot distribution of a specific star is not trivial.
As such, it was not implemented in our simulation.
